name: std::ispunct(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool ispunct(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a punctuation character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as punctuation, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
isalpha('⅋', C locale) returned false
isalpha('⅋', Unicode locale) returned true
